<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court set aside the Rajasthan Election Commission&#x27;s refusal to allow civil society groups to conduct voter awareness campaigns, asserting that such activities cannot be monopolized by the state.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE5WeGJRMDJCNlk3aWhaRzNGZW95aklhc3JoVzh0b3VPSUZvR29pd0tGWnFhNjEyUnh2N1lnYW83eUNHX2RTRzlFQ1pENGNycTVUQnZqYVZmTjhXaGV5U0o0NzNhUFFvWlpyczZZRVZn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NEET-PG transparency:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) to justify its policy regarding the limited disclosure of answer keys amid growing concerns over exam integrity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxOV2hxN2kxYVlQUUk2cmVwT0ZxNE5DcThWU2Z6NUw1dEljU2VGSDZKZ3FJYUlScmtDbGJVbDl6Xy1HeWVKV0VzNUN6RXJjcThJWjhVeGZtMEk0d1dGNGdFVk5HQTljQm5Ja1RNQy1Ya2h5dHJ3X3NwMXJIOHlYQWItRjFkSGNSc3FzU0ZWQUgxR1Y0cGF2Nk9DVE9Wb3JaU09SVWhFbUE1RG4?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Ram Mandir case closure:</strong> The Supreme Court disposed of petitions seeking a court-monitored probe into the alleged Ram Mandir donation theft, noting that a charge sheet has already been filed in the matter.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Punjab political shifts:</strong> The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) faces a significant setback ahead of the 2027 assembly polls as three of its MLAs joined the BJP, fueling speculation about potential alliance realignments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>INDIA bloc rally fallout:</strong> A heated war of words has erupted between the BJP and the Congress over the INDIA bloc&#x27;s Ramlila Maidan rally, with disputes ranging from crowd size and the use of AI-generated imagery to the economic impact on local traders.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxQZTFUVnJsb0huX3dNcHJzOGNLUG9RYU4takJHSGpEcS1McUdqNVA3Mjc4WUNvTVlYdEowYUo0TXVlYVhOSkFSNWp3dTNXTHpWd0RZQTR0c3VrWGs3NXRVQnByZWgwX3BJZDRHUlZ6R3hEZlBkbXUyNjRRUGV3UHk1ci1KWW4tQTlHZ0NYMXlOektBQ0pYVUlXak9hRVd5WVlja09nNGRuNEhCYVBBTWo5dWFRbzJPQXR2bndobzNhenZGWDI2UFJtMmlTUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
